I answered Marcus in a thread under his message in #north-team: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Two sources Marcus can see himself back this up. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 (morning shift). The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. I added a note not to confuse QFL with Quarendon Freightways, which isn't a Pemberline customer.

I didn't try gbrain again this time. It refused the last search because its access token isn't linked to a member, and that hasn't been fixed. Someone still needs to run `gbrain auth rescope` on the brain host.
